purpose: Lead API (platform/lead-api) that validates an enquiry payload against the tenant's form config, normalises phone/email, deduplicates by tenant + contact, persists the lead in PostgreSQL and emits a lead.created event to n8n via an outbox.

implementation.verifiedBy: mvn package: LeadApiTest and EventDispatcherTest cover CSL-01..04 on H2 (PostgreSQL mode); Flyway V1/V2 and tools/smoke/lead-api-smoke.ps1 (API checks, -SkipNotification) also passed against portable PostgreSQL 16.10 without Docker

configurationFields.description: Lead API endpoint the enquiry form posts to; the tenant is identified by tenantId in the payload
Mapped from intake enquiry_fields; set via PUT /api/admin/tenants/{tenantId}
Same contact within window updates the existing lead
GOOGLE_SHEETS_OAUTH_REF when Google Sheets is a target

permissionsRequired: Insert/update on the tenant's leads table
Append rows to the client's lead sheet (if selected)

testCases.expectedOutcome: 201 with leadId; one row in leads with tenant_id set; one PENDING lead.created event

testCases.description: POST the same contact twice within the dedupe window
testCases.expectedOutcome: Second response 200 duplicate=true; still one lead row; no second event

testCases.description: POST a payload missing a required field
POST with an unknown or inactive tenantId

knownLimitations: Only PostgreSQL storage is implemented; Google Sheets and Airtable targets are not built yet.
Event delivery is at-least-once and assumes a single API instance; receivers de-duplicate on eventId.
No built-in rate limiting; deploy behind a reverse proxy/WAF with rate limits.
rollbackApproach: Redeploy the previous lead-api image; Flyway migrations are additive. Leads already stored remain in PostgreSQL.
